name: Tokoname (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Tokoname city emblem in white: a stylised vessel of stacked segments, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Tokoname, a city in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 June 1955.

features.role: Tokoname city emblem — a stylised vessel of stacked segments, like a stylised character
